findings.title: Declaration grammar accepts generic phrases and deictic prefixes as named declarations
findings.trigger: Any English sentence ending in product/service/system/material/... or Chinese generic phrase ending in 系列/产品线, and even a deictic such as 这些产品线.
findings.evidence: Real final code: HK 2 and US 10 REFERENCE_UNRESOLVED, with observed generic-family examples (These products/our products/services/system). Synthetic: 'We sell products and services.' + 'These products...' -> unique with generic context; 'The company sells microproducts' -> declaration; '公司产品系列丰富' + '该系列产品' -> unique; '这些产品线' is itself a declaration.
findings.impact: Can resolve a deictic to a non-named phrase and hand the model an incorrect declaration context; also causes real over-deferral. Violates contract 3/6.2 explicit named declaration.
findings.fix: Require a bounded, name-like token; reject function-word/verb phrases and deictic/generic CJK prefixes; forbid a head inside a longer word; add generic EN/CJK/deictic negatives.

findings.title: Proven furniture skip compares the wrong neighbour and can accept the wrong carry
findings.evidence: Window p2: predecessors=(), complete=False, unproved_order, because _adjacent compares p1 to the skipped header. With only carry (p1,header), p1 is accepted/complete=True.
findings.impact: Real PDF cross-page with a header/footer still fails or is proved by the wrong edge; violates contract 2 'Proven furniture may be skipped by existing source-flow proof' and the v2 claim.
findings.fix: Track last accepted prose (or target) as the adjacency anchor; skip furniture without changing it; add proven-furniture and wrong-carry tests.

findings.title: Chinese 系统/平台/方案 family deictics can never be closed
findings.trigger: 上述系统 / 这些平台 / 该等方案; declaration 公司推出Omega系统/平台/方案.
findings.evidence: Deictic head defaults to 产品, family=True; find_product_declarations(Omega系统/平台/方案) returns (); closure missing.
findings.impact: Family deictics that v1 could resolve (Latin-named system/platform/solution) now always defer; over-deferral/regression.
findings.fix: Map 系统/平台/方案 to supported classes or disable family gating for unsupported heads; add three tests.

findings.title: Same-sentence unrelated 包括/含 still becomes collective members
findings.trigger: 公司客户包括华为、小米，公司推出X系列产品，已量产。
findings.evidence: X系列 collective=True, members 华为/小米; the cross-sentence version is correctly False.
findings.impact: Wrong collective status/member_refs; customer/non-product items become product members.
findings.fix: Only accept a collective marker after the declaration head/appositive; reject subject/other-clause markers; add same-sentence negative.

findings.title: Attribution prefix heuristic drops legitimate issuer statements about customers
findings.trigger: 客户高度认可X系列产品，已开始批量采购。 / 据客户反馈，X系列产品性能优异。
findings.evidence: Declaration attribution=quoted_related_party; target 该系列产品 -> missing. '公司向客户交付X系列产品' -> issuer/unique.
findings.impact: Over-deferral of legitimate issuer product declarations; attribution isn't preserved as context, it is discarded. Also any sentence with 公司 is classified issuer even if it quotes a customer.
findings.fix: Judge attribution by clause subject/actor using existing NP grammar; keep non-issuer attribution as context rather than dropping; add positive/negative tests.
